newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO sees no rivals for SFB.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO sees no rivals for SFB.

text.p: ABN AMRO said on Friday it saw little chance of a rival bidder emerging for Standard Federal Bancorp., the U.S. savings bank it plans to buy.
Executive board chairman Jan Kalff said Standard Federal had used an investment bank to search the market for a buyer and was unlikely to have overlooked any interested parties.
He said ABN AMRO had emerged as the highest bidder in a private auction.
Asked about the possibility another bidder might emerge, he told a news conference: "The chances are not zero but they're very small."
But he said ABN AMRO, which is offering $59 per share in a bid valuing Standard Federal at $1.9 billion, had the support of holders of less than 10 percent of the shares at present.
Standard Federal, based in the state of Michigan, has a widely spread shareholder base, with the biggest four shareholders owning about 25 percent of the shares.
Kalff said the Dutch bank did not currently own any shares in its target and would approach shareholders to convince them to accept the offer.
He said ABN AMRO could buy out the minority shareholders once it had reached a certain level of ownership.
He did not specify this level.
"It's not a done deal yet but we are confident it will go ahead," Kalff added.
Kalff said the management of Standard Federal had taken the initiative to find a buyer because the bank was growing faster than its capital.
This was against a background of rapid consolidation in banking in the United States, which still has about 10,000 banks.
"They are a very fast growing thrift and they felt the time was right to merge or be acquired," he said.
Kalff said Standard Federal represented a "beautiful geographic fit" with LaSalle National Corp, the ABN AMRO unit which is the second largest bank in Chicago.
"Our critical mass has risen considerably," he said.

Most of ABN AMRO's U.S. interests are based in Illinois, which it first entered with the LaSalle buy in 1979, and this would be the first time it has moved into the neighbouring states of Michigan, Indiana and Ohio.
"We have crossed the state border for the first time," he said.
